rd.heading: Research and development expense
rd.text:
Research and development (“R&D”) expense includes the costs associated with our internal research and development activities, including compensation and benefits, occupancy costs, manufacturing costs, costs of expert consultants, and administrative costs. R&D expense increased 58% to $1.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $1.1 million for the three

months ended September 30, 2025. The increased expense was primarily due to increased professional fees and other costs associated with both the timing of our clinical trials (the randomized study and U.S. site start up), pre-clinical activities and the manufacture of clinical trial materials.

ga.heading: General and administrative expense
ga.text: General and administrative (“G&A”) expense consists primarily of personnel costs, facility expenses, and professional fees. G&A expense decreased 44% to $1.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $1.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decreased expense was primarily due to a decrease in professional fees inclusive of Legal Fees and audit and tax fees and other G&A costs related to stock option expenses.

nonop.heading: Other income (expense), net
nonop.text: Other income, net decreased to approximately $13,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $241,000 of other income, net for the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to foreign currency exchange losses in the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to foreign currency exchange gains in the three months ended September 30, 2026.

ocf.text: Net cash used in operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was $5.1 million and $3.9 million, respectively. Our future ability to generate cash from operations will depend on achieving regulatory approval and market acceptance of our product candidates, and our ability to enter into collaborations.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text: We recognized approximately $0.2 million of pre-commercial product revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from agenT-797 supplied on a paid, per-patient basis under our named-patient access program in Brazil. We did not recognize any revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

intro.text: MiNK Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing off-the-shelf allogeneic iNKT cell therapies for life-threatening conditions driven by immune dysfunction. The company's lead program, agenT-797, is being evaluated in acute lung injury and critical illness, with a pipeline that extends across immuno-oncology, transplant medicine, and other settings where dysregulated immunity is a driver of morbidity and mortality. MiNK believes that iNKT cell biology, because of its regulatory role across innate and adaptive immunity, may represent a foundational approach to immune restoration applicable across a broad range of conditions. For more information, visit www.minktherapeutics.com .

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
